items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Benny Carter gave up the band and I went with Willie Bryant

ctx.x: And then that job, after awhile, when that job folded, Benny Carter gave up the band and I went with Willie Bryant, and Benny Carter went with Willie Bryant as musical director, so he put Willie Bryant's band in the shape that Benny Carter's band was, so Willie Bryant had done that, and he was doing a lot of network broadcasting with this band, an excellent band, and made quite a few Victor records, the Willie Bryant band.
And out of that, I began to play for an excellent group from Cincinnati that had come to New York called the Charioteers, a singing group.
